{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent age inclusion criterion",
      "quote": "Age ≥ 21 years at time of consent.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states age ≥21, but the protocol body may have a different age criterion (e.g., ≥18) which is common in oncology trials. This discrepancy could lead to enrollment of ineligible subjects or exclusion of eligible ones.",
      "fix": "Verify and align the age criterion between synopsis and body; specify the correct minimum age."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent exclusion criterion for prior radiation",
      "quote": "Received radiation therapy (or other nonsystemic therapy) within 2 weeks before first dose of study treatment on W1D1.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exclusion criterion says radiation within 2 weeks is exclusionary, but the inclusion criterion 4c requires documented progression in a previously radiated lesion. This is contradictory and may confuse sites about eligibility of patients with recent radiation.",
      "fix": "Clarify the allowed interval between radiation and study entry, and reconcile with the requirement for progression in a radiated lesion."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial schema",
      "quote": "Thin or missing sections: M11 1.2 Trial Schema (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Trial Schema",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a trial schema figure, which is essential for understanding the study flow, treatment schedule, and assessment timing.",
      "fix": "Add a trial schema diagram showing screening, treatment cycles, assessments, and follow-up."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial stopping rules",
      "quote": "M11 4.3 Trial Stopping Rules (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Trial Stopping Rules",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "No explicit stopping rules for the trial are provided, which is a safety and operational gap.",
      "fix": "Define criteria for early trial termination (e.g., safety, futility, or administrative)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing access to trial intervention after end of trial",
      "quote": "M11 4.5 Access to Trial Intervention After End of Trial (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Access to Trial Intervention After End of Trial",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe post-trial access to CMP-001 or nivolumab for subjects who may benefit, which is an ethical and regulatory requirement.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing post-trial access provisions or state that none is planned."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing lifestyle restrictions",
      "quote": "M11 5.5 Lifestyle Restrictions (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Lifestyle Restrictions",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "No lifestyle restrictions (e.g., diet, alcohol, smoking, sexual activity) are specified, which may be relevant for safety and PK.",
      "fix": "Add a section detailing any lifestyle restrictions during the trial."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size determination",
      "quote": "M11 10.11 Sample Size Determination (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Sample Size Determination",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol states 100 subjects planned but provides no statistical justification or assumptions for this number.",
      "fix": "Include a sample size calculation with assumptions (e.g., expected ORR, power, alpha)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data sharing and trial registration",
      "quote": "SPIRIT 4 Trial registration (missing), SPIRIT 6 Data sharing (missing)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Trial Registration and Data Sharing",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention trial registration (e.g., ClinicalTrials.gov) or a data sharing plan, which are required by many journals and funders.",
      "fix": "Add sections for trial registration and data sharing policy."
    }
  ]
}
